h1: The 5 Best Electric Pruning Shears for DeWalt 20V Users, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: DeWalt Electric Pruning Shears: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 5 electric pruning shears for DeWalt 20V MAX batteries, from the genuine DCPR320 to compatible tools, scored on cut and value.
summary: The DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Pruner (DCPR320D1) is the pick for genuine DeWalt backing and warranty support. The starter bundle with a 4 Ah battery and charger is for anyone without 20V MAX batteries, and the compatible brushless shears with a 1.4 inch cut are a budget route for those who already own batteries. The YAWV tools add adjustable cutting diameters.
intro: The cheapest DeWalt-compatible pruners cost a fraction of the genuine one, and that gap tempts a lot of owners. The trap is that several of them are sold tool only, with no battery and no charger, so the price on the listing is not the price of a working setup. If you already own 20V MAX batteries, a compatible shear can be a bargain. If you do not, a single battery and charger cost more than the tool.

We ranked five pruners that run on DeWalt's 20V MAX battery platform. We reviewed listings for cut capacity, battery inclusion, blade steel, motor type and whether the product is genuine DeWalt or a third-party tool built to fit. Two Milwaukee-compatible tools from the original pool were left out, since they do not fit DeWalt batteries. Cut sizes are the sellers' claims, and third-party tools carry no DeWalt warranty.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Pruner (DCPR320D1)
products.verdict: The genuine DeWalt 20V MAX pruner, with brand warranty and support behind it.
products.description:
This is DeWalt's own DCPR320D1 cordless pruner, designed for the 20V MAX battery platform. The listing names it as genuine and places it in the $100 to $200 range.

It wins because it is the one DeWalt stands behind. A genuine tool means warranty service, a known cutting head and replacement blades through DeWalt channels, which is what you want in a power tool that sits in your hand and cuts at high torque. The DCPR320 family is listed at 1-1/2 inches of cutting capacity in the bundle below, which covers most garden pruning. The listing does not describe the blade design or motor, so we limit our claims to the platform and brand.

Pick it when your shed already holds DeWalt packs and you want a pruner with proper support. Check whether the kit includes a battery before you order.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want genuine DeWalt backing and warranty support.
products.skipIf: You want the lowest possible price.

products.name: Dewalt DCPR320BDCB240C-BNDL 20V MAX 1-1/2 in. Cordless Pruner and 4 Ah Battery and Charger Starter Kit Bundle
products.verdict: The genuine 1-1/2 inch pruner with a 4 Ah battery and charger in one bundle.
products.description:
This bundle pairs the DeWalt DCPR320B pruner, a 1-1/2 inch cutter, with a 4 Ah 20V MAX battery and a charger. It is in the $200 to $500 bracket.

It ranks second because it is the complete setup for someone who owns no DeWalt batteries. A 4 Ah pack gives a good amount of cutting between charges, and having the charger in the box means you can start the day you open it. The cost is higher than the tool-only listing, but buying the same battery and charger separately costs about as much. It loses the top slot only because buyers who already have batteries pay for items they do not need.

Choose it if you are starting fresh with the DeWalt 20V MAX platform. The battery also powers other tools in the range.
products.idealFor: Buyers starting fresh without an existing 20V MAX battery.
products.skipIf: You already own DeWalt 20V MAX batteries.

products.name: Brushless Electric Pruning Shears for DeWalt 20V Battery with 1.4-Inch Cut
products.verdict: A brushless, DeWalt-compatible shear with a 1.4 inch cut at the lowest price.
products.description:
These third-party brushless pruning shears fit DeWalt 20V batteries and are listed with a 1.4 inch cut. They sit in the $25 to $50 bracket, tool only.

It ranks third because the cost-to-capacity ratio is the best in the group. A 1.4 inch cut is only a tenth of an inch below the genuine DeWalt, and a brushless motor is a plus for efficiency and life. Savings are real for owners who have spare batteries. The drawbacks are no DeWalt warranty, unknown long-term support and the lack of a battery in the box.

Pick it when spare DeWalt packs are lying around and savings matter most. Do not choose it if you need professional-grade backing.
products.idealFor: Buyers who already own DeWalt 20V batteries and want maximum savings.
products.skipIf: You need warranty support from DeWalt.

products.name: YAWV Brushless Electric Pruning Shears for Dewalt 20V Battery, Adjustable Cutting Diameter 1.2-1.6 Inch (Tool Only)
products.verdict: An adjustable 1.2 to 1.6 inch cut with SK5 blades, the largest cut among compatibles.
products.description:
This YAWV tool fits DeWalt 20V batteries and has an adjustable cutting diameter of 1.2 to 1.6 inches. It has SK5 blades and is sold tool only at $50 to $100.

It ranks fourth because its 1.6 inch maximum is the biggest cut among the DeWalt-compatible options, and the adjustment lets you limit the opening for smaller stems. SK5 is a high carbon steel commonly used in blades, and it holds an edge but can rust if left wet. The tool carries no DeWalt warranty and no battery is included.

Choose it if you want the most cutting capacity from a compatible tool. Wipe the blades dry after use.
cons: Blades can rust if left wet
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the most cutting capacity among DeWalt-compatible options.
products.skipIf: You need a battery in the box.

products.name: YAWV Brushless Electric Pruning Shears for DeWalt Battery, Adjustable Cutting Diameter 0.8-1.2 Inch (NO Battery)
products.verdict: An adjustable 0.8 to 1.2 inch cut for vines, roses and fruit-tree shoots.
products.description:
This smaller YAWV tool fits DeWalt batteries and adjusts from 0.8 to 1.2 inches. It uses SK5 blades, ships without a battery and costs $25 to $50.

It finishes fifth because the capacity is the smallest here. A 1.2 inch maximum covers vines, rose canes, raspberry canes and the shoots of fruit trees, which is a huge share of garden pruning, but it will not take thicker limbs. The adjustable diameter is a safety and battery-saving feature, since a smaller opening means a shorter stroke on thin stems.

Buy it for light pruning on a budget. For anything thicker, choose the 1.4 or 1.6 inch tools.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want adjustable cutting diameter in a DeWalt-compatible tool.
products.skipIf: You prune branches over an inch thick.

whatMatters.detail: DeWalt's 20V MAX batteries fit a wide range of its tools, and compatible tools borrow the same battery connection. If you already own packs, you only need the tool. Check the listing for tool only or bare tool wording before you price a setup.

A genuine DeWalt tool comes with a warranty, known parts and a dedicated support channel. A compatible tool costs less but depends on the seller for support. Weigh the saving against the cost of failure, especially for frequent use.

Capacity is the largest branch diameter the blades can cut, usually 1 to 1.6 inches for battery shears. Cutting near the limit is slower and harder on the battery. Choose a tool rated above your typical branch.
Brushless motors have no wearing carbon brushes, which usually means longer life and better efficiency. They tend to cost more. Look for the word brushless on the listing, and treat it as a plus.
SK5 is a high-carbon steel that holds a sharp edge but can rust if left wet. Cleaning off sap and drying the blade after use extends its life. Check whether replacement blades are sold for your tool.

faq.q: Will compatible shears fit my DeWalt battery?
faq.a: They are listed as compatible with DeWalt 20V batteries, but fit can vary slightly between third-party designs. Check reviews and the return policy. Make sure your pack is a 20V MAX type.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake with cheap compatible tools?
faq.a: Ignoring that most are sold without a battery or charger. The low price covers only the tool. Count the cost of batteries if you do not already own them.

faq.q: Is the genuine DeWalt worth it over a compatible tool?
faq.a: It is if you prune regularly or want warranty support. A compatible tool is fine for occasional use and costs far less. The risk with cheap tools is fit and durability.

faq.q: How do I set the cutting diameter on the YAWV tools?
faq.a: The YAWV tools have an adjustment that limits how wide the blade opens, within the stated range. Set it to the thickness of the stems you cut. Follow the maker's instructions for the control.

faq.q: How do I look after the blades?
faq.a: Wipe off sap and moisture after each session, and apply a thin film of oil to the blade and pivot. Store the tool dry. Replace blades that are chipped or dull.

faq.q: Can I cut thicker branches with these?
faq.a: Not safely. Cutting beyond the rated capacity risks stalling the motor and damaging the blades. Use a loppers or a saw for anything over the stated size.

finalTake: The genuine DEWALT DCPR320D1 is the best electric pruner for DeWalt users who want warranty support, and the starter bundle is the better buy if you need a battery. For savings, the compatible brushless 1.4 inch shears are the strongest value, and the YAWV 1.2 to 1.6 inch tool offers the most capacity among the compatibles.
